songs.title: Abba Father
songs.source: wp-content/uploads/Songs/Abba Father.mp3
songs.lyrics:
Abba, Father, Abba, Father
Bring About A Change In Me
Master, Saviour, cleanse me from iniquity.
Stretch forth Your Hand
and make me whole.
I stand awaiting the victory
O’er the kingdoms, the kingdoms
That war within my soul.

Jesus, Jesus
Arouse us from our darkened sleep.
Glorious Messiah,
cry unto us as deep cries unto deep
I seek your life and not my own;
Come fill this place with Your Majesty
That Your Kingdom, Your Kingdom
Might rule within my soul.

Holy, Holy Spirit,
I yield myself to Your Command.
Wonderful, Counsellor,
I give to Thee that I might stand.
Come take Your place and rightful throne
I praise You now for the Victory
of Your Kingdom, Your Kingdom
that rules within my soul.

By Bro Jerry. Cover by Sons of Asaph Music
